text: Wed, Sep 16 example Why this plan Hold the bench at 105 and let the reps come back. Two short sets last time; the engine keeps the load until the reps are clean. YOUR CALORIES About 2,300 kcal: measured maintenance less the rate band, never below the floor. YOUR PROTEIN At least 160 g: a provisional target from the available lean-mass input, not a measured personal minimum. WHAT SUPPORTS CUTTING Lifts holding while the scale falls, confirmed a week apart. THE READINGS BEHIND IT 14 clean weigh-ins over 28 days. THE RATE ITSELF About 0.9 lb a week, between 0.6 and 1.2, measured across those readings.
